idea_text: Internal developer platform: self-service infrastructure provisioning, CI/CD pipeline management, monitoring dashboards, and on-call rotation. Target: 200-person engineering org. Must reduce average deployment time from 45min to under 10min. Integrate with existing GitHub, Datadog, and PagerDuty.
target_audience: Platform engineers and SREs who manage infrastructure for 200+ developers. Currently using manual Terraform + Jenkins with no self-service.
